info.title: About JPJ Enterprise
info.intro: JPJ is a specialized drilling company with many years of experience. We implement advanced geotechnical and geological projects for private and industrial sectors.
info.mission_p: Providing precise soil data and energy solutions through innovative drilling technologies while maintaining the highest safety standards.
info.history_p: Since its founding by Jan Paweł Jarosiński, JPJ has completed over 500 drilling projects nationwide, constantly modernizing its machinery park.
info.future_p: We invest in drilling systems with reduced noise and pollution emissions, adapting to increasing EU environmental requirements.

realizations.title: Our Realizations
realizations.help_desc: We will be happy to provide support and help resolve any doubts regarding your investment.

p1.title: Deep well drilling for an industrial plant
p1.description: Execution of a professional water intake with a depth of 85m. The project included pump selection and installation of pressure tanks.

p2.title: Ground source for heat pumps – office building
p2.description: Comprehensive execution of 12 vertical boreholes, 100m each. Double-pipe probes were used for maximum thermal efficiency.

p3.title: Geotechnical investigations for a logistics hall
p3.description: Series of exploratory drillings and static CPTU soundings to determine the strength parameters of the ground for foundations.

p4.title: Installation of monitoring piezometer network
p4.description: Execution of observation boreholes for continuous monitoring of groundwater quality at a former landfill site.

p5.title: Exploratory borehole for thermal water
p5.description: Deep exploratory drilling with full coring to analyze the potential of geothermal waters in the region.

geologia.description: We investigate the ground for construction. We perform drillings and soundings essential for safe foundation design.
